# Darmon — Mathème (1992)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Marc Darmon, “Mathème,” *Dictionnaire*, Association Lacanienne Internationale, July 29, 1992, accessed July 14, 2026, https://www.freud-lacan.com/documents-ged/matheme/.

**Shortened note:** Darmon, “Mathème.”

**Bibliography:** Darmon, Marc. “Mathème.” *Dictionnaire*. Association Lacanienne Internationale, July 29, 1992. Accessed July 14, 2026. https://www.freud-lacan.com/documents-ged/matheme/.

## Essay use

The specialist dictionary entry supplies a recoverable, French-language account of the Lacanian matheme as formal writing that aims to denote psychoanalytic structure and to transmit it. It also states that an early Lacanian matheme was adapted from Saussure's `S/s` algorithm.

**Claim boundary:** this is an Association Lacanienne Internationale reference entry, not a selected Lacan primary edition or a source for the QL crossed-zero sequence. It cannot establish QL's `0/1`, Sanskrit terms, the mytheme, machine subjectivity, or an identity between psychoanalysis and mathematics.

<a id="darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q001"></a>
## Passage card — `darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q001` — Matheme as structural writing and transmission
^darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q001

> “Le mathème n’est pas une simple abréviation, ou une inscription sténographique, mais il a l’ambition de dénoter une structure réellement en cause dans le discours psychanalytique et à partir de là dans les autres discours. Par l’écriture, le mathème ressemble aux formules algébriques et formelles existant en mathématiques, en logique et dans les sciences mathématisées et pour Lacan il s’agissait là du pont rattachant la psychanalyse à la science.”

- **Locator:** “Mathème,” opening definition, paras. 1–2; public page lines 204–206 in the 2026-07-14 inspection.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the public French HTML; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** supports.
- **Argument function:** primary formulation / technical context.
- **Consumers:** [[34-s4-p3-lacan-matheme-mytheme]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit|Immutable Gap and Meta-Sign]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; movement 34 matheme definition.
- **Use boundary:** establishes the entry's account of matheme as structural psychoanalytic writing and a transmission aim; it does not establish the QL sequence, a mathematical theorem, or a universal theory of signification.

<a id="darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q002"></a>
## Passage card — `darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q002` — Linguistic derivation and barred signifier/signified relation
^darmon-1992-matheme-ali-q002

> “Le premier mathème lacanien est en fait emprunté après une légère transformation à la linguistique : il s’agit de l’algorithme S/s dû à F. de Saussure, qui dispose signifiant et signifié de part et d’autre d’une barre.”

- **Locator:** “La formule du signifiant,” opening sentence; public page line 209 in the 2026-07-14 inspection.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
